messages.味方が付けた振動を足場に、振動の多い敵へ強化されたスキルでマッチと火力を受け持つ: A main attacker for Tremor teams, using allies' Tremor application to enhance his clashes and damage against high-Tremor enemies. His own Tremor application is modest.
messages.敵の振動で強化: S1「履行勧告」は対象の振動3、S2「最終警告」・S3「執行宣: **Bonuses from enemy Tremor**: Coin Power rises based on the target's Tremor, with a threshold of 3 for S1 Execution Advised and 6 for S2 Final Warning and S3 Execution Sentencing (up to 2; +1 at or above the threshold at lower Uptie, +1 per threshold at higher Uptie).
messages.バトルパッシブ「厳重な立会い」(傲慢×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得): 対象の振動威: **Combat passive — Grave Attendance (4 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: +5%/10% damage per 6 Tremor Potency on the target, up to 15%/30%. When his own skill effect converts the target into Tremor - Decay, it triggers Tremor Burst on that target (Uptie Ⅳ).
messages.自分で付ける振動は少なめ: S1はⅡコインで振動回数+2、S2は振動2×2、S3: **He inflicts little Tremor himself**: S1 adds +2 Tremor Count with Coin Ⅱ, S2 inflicts 2 Tremor ×2, and S3 inflicts 1 Tremor ×2. The Defense skill Do Not Obstruct adds +1 to the attacker's Tremor Count when he takes damage while he has Shield (does not stack).
messages.振動-崩壊: S3のⅢコインの的中時、対象の振動威力と回数の合計が20以上なら振: **Tremor - Decay**: On Coin Ⅲ hit of S3, if the target's combined Tremor Potency and Count is 20 or more, it performs Amplitude Conversion into Tremor - Decay. The target's Defense Level drops by 1 per 4 Tremor Potency. Amplitude Conversion changes Tremor into another type, so it also overwrites any other amplitude already applied.
messages.サポートパッシブ「義務履行の確認」(傲慢×6・保有・同期化Ⅲで取得): 速度が最: **Support passive — Verify Obligation Fulfillment (6 Pride Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ)**: +1 Clash Power for skills that inflict Tremor Potency or Count used by the 1 fastest ally.
messages.振動を多く付与できる味方と組み、その振動を利用して高いマッチ威力とダメージ量で戦: Pair him with allies who can inflict plenty of Tremor, and use that Tremor to fight with high Clash Power and damage. Reaching 20 total Tremor alone is difficult, so use him to take on Clashes that protect the Tremor-applying allies. If an ally has applied a more useful amplitude (such as Tremor - Reverb), hold back S3 so it is not overwritten. His main stage is Focused Encounters, where Tremor is easier to maintain.
